senses.gloss: तनु- + अंशुक तनु- + अंशुक, n. a thin cloth.
तनु- + अङ्ग तनु- + अङ्ग, f. गी, a delicate woman.
तनू-ज- + अङ्ग तनू-ज- + अङ्ग, n. a wing.
तनु- + उद्भव तनु- + उद्भव, m. a son.
तनु- + छद तनु- + छद, 1. adj. covering the body, Rām. 4, 63, 2. 2. m. a coat of mail, MBh. 12, 4424.

तंस् तंस्, i. 1 and 10, Par. 1. To shake (ved.).
 2. † To adorn.

1. तन् तन्, ii. 8, तनु, Par., Ātm.
 1. To draw (a bow), MBh. 4, 141.
 2. To spread, Bhag. 2, 17.
 3. To cover, Śiś. 9, 23.
 4. To propagate, Hariv. 2386.
 5. To augment, Śāk. d. 19.
 6. To direct, Nalod. 1, 20.
 7. To arrange, Man. 4, 205.
 8. To cause (pleasure or pain), Ragh. 3, 25; Bhāg. P. 1, 18, 37.
 9. To speak, Daśak. 7 ult. Pass. तन्य, and ताय; ptcple. तत.
 --With the prep. अति अति, अतितत, Very haughty, Śiś. 19, 3.
 --With अधि अधि, To cover, Rām. 5, 12, 33.
 --With अनु अनु,
 1. To augment, MBh. 12, 4816.
 2. To maintain, MBh. 3, 12681.
 --With अव अव,
 1. To descend, अवतत, Descending, Hariv. 3621.
 2. To cover, MBh. 6, 2666.
 --With आ आ,
 1. with पदम्, To get a footing, Bhartṛ. 1, 32.
 2. To stretch, MBh. 5, 4164; to draw, Ragh. [] 1, 19.
 3. To effuse, Śāk. d. 193.
 4. To grant, Bhāg. P. 5, 24, 22.
 5. To cause, Bhartṛ. 1, 50.
 6. To arrange, Bhartṛ. 1, 36.
 --With समा सम्-आ, To procure, Rājat. 4, 247. समातत, Violent, MBh. 8, 4205.
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To spread, Suśr. 1, 354, 5.
 2. To show, Śiś. 2, 30.
 3. To cover, Rām. 3, 76, 25.
 4. To begin (a sacrifice), MBh. 12, 9613.
 5. To cause, Rājat. 2, 78.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To spread out, MBh. 1, 1335.
 2. To stretch out, Mṛcch. 143, 21.
 3. To draw, MBh. 1, 5290.
 4. To cover, Rām. 3, 63, 13.
 5. To arrange (a sacrifice), Man. 3, 28.
 6. To show, Rām. 4, 9, 89. वितत,
 1. Large, Bhāg. P. 5, 16, 7.
 2. Powerful, Rājat. 5, 22.
 --With आवि आ-वि, To illuminate, Bhāg. P. 5, 20, 37.
 --With प्रवि प्र-वि, प्रवितत,
 1. Large, Megh. 104.
 2. Begun, MBh. 5, 5317.
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To cover, Rām. 6, 21, 1.
 2. To fill up, Bhāg. P. 8, 23, 14.
 3. To expand, Bhāg. P. 1, 3, 37. संतत,
 1. Uninterrupted, Lass. 96, 9.
 2. Eternal.
 3. Extended.
 4. Much. ˚तम्, adv. Eternally.
 --Caus. तानय, To cause to be performed, Bhāg. P. 4, 7, 16.
 --With अनुसम् अनु-सम्,
 1. To spread, Bhag. 15, 2.
 2. To cover, Rām. 5, 16, 8.
 --With अभि-सम् अभि-सम्, To cover, Hariv. 4986.
 --Cf. τάνυμαι, ἔκ-τατος (= तत), τιταίνω (for τιτανϳω), τείνω (for τενϳω), ἐπιτηδές (for ταν + tvas); Lat. tenere, tendere, ostendere (for obs-), tenus, etc.; O.H.G. danjan; A.S. thenian; see also तनु.

2. तन् तन् (akin to स्तन्), i. 4, Par. To sound (ved.).
 --Cf. τόνος; Lat. tonare; O.H.G. donar; A.S. thunor.

† 3. तन् तन् (or वन् वन्), i. 1 and 10, तानय, Par.
 1. To believe. []
 2. To assist (or to afflict, or to be afflicted).
 3. To sound (cf. 2. तन्).
 4. With prepositions, To stretch (cf. 1. तन्).

तनय तनय (vb. 1. तन्, anomal. Caus. + अ),
 I. adj. Continuing a family, Chr. 291, 14 = Rigv. i. 64, 14.
 II. m.
 1. A son.
 2. du. A son and a daughter.
 III. f. या, A daughter.
 --Comp.
 See कु-.

तनु तन् + उ,
 I. adj., f. नु and न्वी,
 1. Thin, Rām. 2, 8, 42 Gorr.
 2. Delicate, Nal. 12, 106.
 3. Moderate (in quantity and size), Man. 3, 10.
 4. Small, MBh. 3, 1747. Comparat. तनीयंस्, Rājat. 3, 223, and तनुतर, Amar. 3. Superl. तनिष्ठ and तनुतम.
 II. f. नु and नू,
 1. The body, Man. 2, 28; Rām. 1, 16, 5.
 2. A person, Man. 4, 184.
 3. One's own self, Hariv. 2386.
 III. f. न्वी, A slender woman, Bhartṛ. 1, 71.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. Lat. tenuis; O.H.G. dunni; A.S. thyn; τανεῖα (= तन्वी), ταναός for ταναϝός (cf. ταναύπους), i. e. τανυ + ο.
तनुक तनु + क, adj. Small, Suśr. 1, 296, 12.
तनुज तनु-ज, m. A son, Pañc. v. d. 22.

तनूज तनू-ज (see तनु),
 I. m. A son, Rām. 2, 43, 20.
 II. f. जा, A daughter, Chr. 52, 10.

तनुता तनु + ता, f.
 1. Smallness, meagerness, Rām. 5, 19, 22; Megh. 83.
 2. in कलभ-, Condition of having the body of a young elephant, Megh. 79.
 --Comp.
तनुत्र तनु-त्र (vb. त्रा), n. A coat of mail, MBh. 4, 1009.
तनुत्रवन्त् तनुत्र + वन्त्, adj. Covered with a coat of mail, Rām. 6, 76, 21.
तनुत्व तनु + त्व, n. Smallness, delicateness, MBh. 13, 541.
तनुस् तन् + उस्, n. The body, Rām. 5, 93, 23.
तनूनपात् तनू-नपात्, m. Fire, or its deity, Hit. ii. d. 66 (read -पातो).

तन्तु तन् + तु, m.
 1. A thread, MBh. 1, 806; epithet of the supreme deity, Being the thread, Bhāg. P. 8, 16, 31.
 2. A cobweb, Vedāntas. in Chr. 206, 13.
 3. A filament, Bhartṛ. 2, 6.
 4. Series, Bhāg. P. 8, 13, 36.
 5. Propagation of a family, race, MBh. 8, 3393; 3, 15363 (on whom depends the propagation).
 6. Issue, Man. 9, 203.
 --Comp.

तन्तुक तन्तु + क,
 1. a substitute for तन्तु, as latter part of a comp. adj., A string, Bhartṛ. 1, 95.
 2. m. A kind of snake, Suśr. 2, 265, 13.
तन्तुवाय तन्तुवाय, i. e. तन्तु-वे + अ, m. A weaver, Man. 8, 397.
तन्तु-, तन्त्र- + वाय तन्तु-, तन्त्र- + वाय, m. 1. a weaver, Man. 8, 397; Rām. 2, 90, 15 Gorr. 2. a spider.

तन्त्र् तन्त्र्, i. 10 (rather a denomin. derived from the following word), Par.
 1. To perform in a regular succession, MBh. 12, 7814.
 2. Ātm. To maintain a family, to govern, Śāk. d. 102, v. r.

तन्त्र तन् + त्र,
 I. n.
 1. A warp, [] MBh. 1, 806.
 2. A series, propagation, offspring, MBh. 13, 2567.
 3. A system, a totality, Bhāg. P. 3, 1, 44; order, MBh. 1, 4171.
 4. The order of ceremonies, a ritual, Bhāg. P. 2, 6, 25.
 5. Necessary or indispensable act, or provision, Rām. 3, 61, 28; 2, 7, 19 Gorr.
 6. Main point, MBh. 14, 612; essence, Bhāg. P. 3, 30, 10; principle, MBh. 12, 7663.
 7. Rule. Yājñ. 1, 228.
 8. Science, Bhāg. P. 3, 7, 30.
 9. A religious or scientific work, a literary work in general, Bhāg. P. 1, 3, 8; 9, 21, 6; Rām. 4, 17, 15.
 10. Part of a work, Suśr. 1, 3, 13; Pañc. pr. d. 3.
 11. A class of mystical and magical writings, treating particularly of spells, charms, etc.
 12. Spell, Pañc. i. d. 80.
 13. An army.
 II. f. री (nom. sing. तन्त्रीस्),
 1. A string, Man. 4, 38; of a bow, MBh. 12, 4375; of a musical instrument, Megh. 84.
 2. Music of a string-instrument, Bhāg. P. 1, 6, 39.
 --Comp.
तान्त्र तान्त्र, i. e. तन्त्री + अ, n. Instrumental music, Rām. 1, 3, 70 Gorr.
तन्त्रक तन्त्र + क, a substitute for तन्त्र, as latter part of comp. words, e. g. पञ्चतन्त्रक, i. e. पञ्चन्-, n. The five books, title of a work.
तन्त्रवाय तन्त्र + वाय, cf. तन्तु-वाय, m. A weaver, Rām. 2, 90, 15 Gorr.
तन्तु-, तन्त्र- + वाय तन्तु-, तन्त्र- + वाय, m. 1. a weaver, Man. 8, 397; Rām. 2, 90, 15 Gorr. 2. a spider.

तन्त्रि तन्त्रि,
 1. for तन्त्री (see तन्त्र), Rām. 6, 28, 26.
 2. for तन्द्रि, MBh. 13, 6538 (ought to be corrected; also तन्त्रित तन्त्रित, sometimes for तन्ड्रित, e. g. MBh. 12, 12713).
तन्त्री तन्त्री, see तन्त्र.
तन्त्रिन् तन्त्रिन्, i. e. तन्त्र + इन्, m. A soldier, Rājat. 5, 248.
तन्द् तन्द्, i. 1 (or 6), Ātm. To slacken (ved.).

तन्द्रा तन्द्रा, i. e. तन्द् + र, f.
 1. Lassitude, Suśr. 1, 13, 8.
 2. Want of energy, MBh. 14, 874; Hit. i. d. 29.
तन्द्रालु तन्द्रा + लु, adj. Weary, Suśr. 2, 403, 4.

तन्द्रि तन्द् + रि,
 I. m. or n. Fatigue, Bhāg. P. 3, 20, 40.
 II. f. री, The same, Rām. 2, 80, 24 Gorr.
 --Comp.
तन्द्रिता तन्द्रिता, i. e. तन्द्रिन् + ता, Lassitude, MBh. 12, 10512.

तन्द्रिन् तन्द्रिन्, i. e. तन्द्रा + इन्, adj., f. इणी, Lazy, MBh. 12, 7740.
 --Comp.
तन्मय तन्मय, i. e. तद् + मय, adj. Having the essence of him, her, it, that, MBh. 3, 1143.
तन्मयता तन्मय + ता, f. and तन्मयत्व तन्मय + त्व, n. Identity with him, her, it, that, Bhāg. P. 1, 2, 2; MBh. 5, 1622.

तन्मात्र तन्मात्र, i. e. तद्-मात्र,
 I. n.
 1. That only, Pañc. i. d. 284.
 2. An atom, or rudimentary element, Vedāntas. in Chr. 206, 19.
 II. adj. Consisting of atoms, Bhāg. P. 3, 10, 15.
तन्मात्र तन्मात्र, see s. v.
तन्मात्रता तन्मात्र + ता, f. and तन्मात्रत्व तन्मात्र + त्व, n. The condition [] of being an atom, or rudimentary principle, Mārk. P. 45, 46, Bhāg. P. 3, 26, 33.

तान तान, i. e. तन् + अ, m.
 1. A thread, Suśr. 1, 93, 17.
 2. A musical [] tone, MBh. 2, 133.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. τόνος.

तानव तानव, i. e. तनु + अ, n.
 1. Meagerness, Rājat. 4, 25.
 2. Smallness, Bhartṛ. 1, 36.

तान्तव तान्तव, i. e. तन्तु + अ, n. Woven cloth, Man. 9, 329.
 --Comp.

तान्त्रिक तान्त्रिक, i. e. तन्त्र + इक,
 I. m. One versed in a system, Bhāṣāp. 148.
 II. adj. Taught in a work of the Tantra-class, Bhāg. P. 8, 6, 9.
तनु- + त्यज् तनु- + त्यज्, adj. 1. dying, Ragh. 1, 8. 2. risking one's life, MBh. 4, 2354.
तनु- + त्याग तनु- + त्याग, m. risking one's life, Rām. 2, 40, 6.
तनू- + देश तनू- + देश, m. a part of the body, Bhāg. P. 7, 13, 12.
तनु- + भाव तनु- + भाव, m. scantiness, Śāk. d. 167.
तनु- + मध्य तनु- + मध्य, adj., f. या, having a slender waist, Nal. 3, 13.

तनू- + रुह तनू- + रुह,
 I. m. a son, Śātr. 10, 52.
 II. n. (and m.). 1. the hair of the body, Arj. 5, 3. 2. the wing of a bird, Varāh. Bṛh. S. 62, 1.
